description: This file defines and configures an Axios instance for interacting with the CHRIS backend API, including setup for environment-based URL, request interception for auth token injection, and response interception for error handling.

methods.name: axios.create
methods.description: Creates an Axios instance with specified configuration.

methods.name: api.interceptors.request.use
methods.description: Adds a request interceptor to inject the auth token into headers.

methods.name: api.interceptors.response.use
methods.description: Adds a response interceptor to handle errors, especially 401 Unauthorized.
